Text: Must establish observational control once Key functional. Cannot be stuck observing fateline for Azandar the camel herder.
References to other fateline methodologies proven frustrating. Fate shaping is impossible, nothing but dead ends.
Ensure mystic binding only applies to my fateline; safety in specificity when it comes to high arcanum.
Research indicates potential for use of fatelines as power source. Immoral, repugnant, unseemly. But interesting.
Send message to Martina after first successful test, Key may fuel social interaction with lessened awkwardness.
Dwemer tonal concepts as core influence suggests further Deep Elf techniques may be of utility to explore.
Send a formal gloating treatise to Shad Astula after experiment success, or request a lecture series?
Full incorporation of tonal architecture into Fateweaver structure proving challenging. More exploration and research required.
Months wasted exploring familial connection to fatelines; will be years before I can stomach my brother's cooking again.
Worth attempting entry to Clockwork City, extra-Nirn structures could prove excellent touchpoint for Fateweaver structure.
I find the Abyssal Sea meditative. Once you adjust to organelles thrumming across the length of your body, it's quite peaceful.
I simply don't understand the average mortal's aversion to tentacles. They seem incredibly useful, if nothing else!
I have, by my count, perfected thirty eight different runeforms and counting. Onward and upward!
My tome is playing a game of hide and seek. Vexing. Will have to check Wayrest Cathedral again, seems to be a favorite spot.
I was awakened last night by Hermaeus Mora intoning pleas and threats from my tome. I threw it across the room and rolled over.
The Baron of the Breakers was in my dreams again last night, offering power. I asked for tea. He was not amused.
I summoned the Fate Crone, and we spoke at length. The ancient hag is a pleasant conversationalist, but not very forthcoming.
Encountered Daedric entity Blind Man in antihelix of the Wind. Marked corridor to avoid, knowledge not worth the danger.
My background studies into the rune knights of old resulted in little more than curious, open ended ephemera.
Finally accepted the whispers and spent an evening meditating before the Colorless Pool. Burned notes after.
New leaf blend still needs something. Rolled oats may prove a textural and flavor compliment.
Months since I last yanked Telenger's chain. Something with that Dwemer monstrosity in the Skywatch plaza? Worth exploring.
(each has a scribbled line through it) Coldharbour, Apocrypha, Evergloam, Colored Rooms, Deadlands, Spiral Skein
